entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: A cyclical planar event that alternately transformed Lorwyn into Shadowmoor and back.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The bright world transformed into Shadowmoor by the Great Aurora.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The shadowy, distorted counterpart of Lorwyn.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The fae queen who orchestrated the Great Aurora.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: An elf killed by Oona and replaced with a faerie vessel; the new Maralen became independent and claimed Oona's title.

entities.name: Great Mending
entities.description: Event that disrupted the fabric of planes across the Multiverse.

entities.name: Sygg
entities.description: A merrow ferryman twisted into a cutthroat.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: An outcast elf who became a safewright of the Wilt-Leaf.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: Ancient treefolk sage whose lingering magic shielded the Sapling of Colfenor.

entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: Protected through her bond with the Crescent of Morningtide.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: The elemental who triggered the Aurora and became the Extinguisher.

entities.name: Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
entities.description: Event that followed the Aurora and Ashling's rampage.

events.summary: Fearing the Aurora, Oona kills Maralen and replaces her body with a faerie vessel as a mental duplicate.
events.quote: Oona sought to preserve herself by killing the elf Maralen and replacing her body with a faerie vessel

events.summary: The new Maralen becomes independent and turns against Oona.
events.quote: a flaw in this act of self-replication allowed this new " Maralen " to become truly independent

events.summary: The Aurora twists Sygg into a cutthroat and makes Rhys a safewright.
events.quote: The merrow Sygg was twisted from a genial ferryman into a merciless cutthroat.

events.summary: Ashling ignites the transformation and becomes the Extinguisher, rampaging across the plane.
events.quote: she ignited the transformation and became a destructive force of nature known as the Extinguisher

relations.note: Killed the elf Maralen to replace her body.
Turned against Oona and claimed her title.
relations.quote: eventually turning against Oona and emerging as a rival for control over the fae
the Great Aurora was orchestrated by the fae queen Oona
